courses.title: Introduction to Graduate Research in the Agricultural Sciences
courses.description: Principles, tools and techniques used in scientific research as applied to the agricultural sciences. Topics will include the development of literature reviews and annotated bibliographies, appropriate literature citation, online research methods and sources, the identification and definition of a research topic and its rationale. Readings, discussions, computer applications, and research.

courses.title: Research Design and Data Analysis for Agriculture
courses.description: Introduction and application of different statistic methods required for the graduate research such as regression, correlation, one and two-way ANOVA with post-hoc tests, Chi-square, and SAS. The basics of design of experiments, such as least factorial design of experiments, hypothesis testing, mean comparisons, regressions and multivariate statistical analysis.
courses.prerequisites: Graduate standing or consent of instructor.

courses.title: Research Proposal
courses.description: The format and content of research proposals and scientific communication culminating with the student’s Master’s thesis research proposal. The student will develop the justification and rationale for the research through a focused review, will develop hypotheses and experimental approaches for testing each hypothesis. Learn to communicate the scientific content of their thesis research to scientists and effectively communicate the same to lay audiences. This will be accomplished through written assignments and PowerPoint presentations.
courses.prerequisites: AG 500 or AG 5100 ; and thesis research project chosen.

courses.title: Animal Science Seminar
courses.description: In depth literature review, seminars and critiques addressing current topics in Animal Science.

courses.title: Special Topics for Graduate Students
courses.description: Group study at a graduate level of a selected well-defined topic or area not covered by a regularly offered course.
courses.prerequisites: Graduate Standing and permission of instructor. Pre or Corequisite(s): Graduate class standing and permission of instructor.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times only with different topics Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units applicable to a degree, with a maximum of 2 sections per semester.

courses.title: Master Thesis / Project Research
courses.description: Individual research in the area of specialization conducted as part of the preparation for writing a thesis under the direction of graduate faculty.

courses.title: Advanced Topics in Animal Physiology
courses.description: An advanced study of the physiology of domestic animals. Recent research developments in animal physiology. Topics include in-depth discussion of the nervous, endocrine, digestive, respiratory, circulatory, and excretory systems
courses.prerequisites: AVS 350 or AVS 3350 , and AVS 350L or AVS 3350L ; or equivalent.

courses.title: Agricultural Science Internship
courses.description: Individualized study, research, or readings in a specialized area under the direction of a faculty member. Maybe be taken up to two times for total credit of 4 units.

courses.title: Directed Research
courses.description: Individual research in a specialized area, under the direction of a graduate faculty member; work does not pertain directly to the thesis.
courses.prerequisites: Graduate standing, and permission of instructor and department chair. Total credit limited to six units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester. Pre or Corequisite(s): Graduate standing, and permission of instructor and department chair. Total credit limited to six units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Independent Research
courses.description: Individual study/investigation and research in a specialized area proposed by the student with the approval, and under the supervision, of a graduate faculty member; work does not pertain directly to the thesis.
courses.prerequisites: Graduate standing, and permission of instructor and department chair. Pre or Corequisite(s): Graduate standing, and permission of instructor and department chair.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Master’s Degree Thesis
courses.description: Compilation, evaluation, interpretation, and report of research for thesis directed by a committee of graduate faculty members. Completion of approved, bound thesis.
courses.prerequisites: Graduate students only. Advancement to Candidacy required.

courses.title: Cal Poly Pomona Graduate Sponsored Summer Experience
courses.description: Enrollment in this 0-unit course allows students to receive university services while participating in a Cal Poly Pomona sponsored summer experience.
